description: Figure 10 illustrates the model's evaluation perplexity (PPL) under varying sparsity settings applied to the Attention and FFN components at different ratios. The x-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0% to 100% in increments of 25%, labeled as "Sparsity Ratio (%)". The y-axis represents the evaluation perplexity, ranging from 10 to 14, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains two lines: a solid blue line representing the Attention component and a dashed red line representing the FFN component. The blue line starts at a PPL of 11.61 at 0% sparsity and remains relatively stable, decreasing slightly to 11.43 at 25% sparsity, then increasing to 12.25 at 50% sparsity, and finally to 12.24 at 75% sparsity. The red line starts at a PPL of 11.61 at 0% sparsity, decreases to 11.31 at 25% sparsity, then increases to 12.05 at 50% sparsity, and finally to 13.20 at 75% sparsity.
